member.name: P:JCass_GoalSeekingModel.BaseClasses.GoalSeekSetup.RunParallel
member.summary: Flag to indicate whether the goal-seeking process should run in parallel. If parallel execution is enabled, the number of variables will still be broken into tranches of 10 iterations, where each 10 iterations will be run in parallel. This is to avoid overloading the system with too many parallel tasks and to facilitate feedback (progress will be reported at the end of each tranche).

member.name: P:JCass_GoalSeekingModel.BaseClasses.GoalSeekSetup.NumberOfVariations
member.summary: Number of variations to be generated for the goal-seeking process. This is the number of samples that will be generated in the Latin Hypercube Sampling (LHS) process. The default value is set to 200, but it can be adjusted based on the requirements of the goal-seeking process. It is recommended to have between 10 and 20 variations for each of the Goal Seek Variables. For example, if there are 10 Goal Seek Variables, then the NumberOfVariations should be set to between 100 and 200.
